about_the_game:
PIQUE! Hook'd on Fishing is a fishing video game that combines the satisfaction of hard work with the tranquility of the sea. Inspired by the progression and collection cycles of great simulation games, it invites you to master your fishing rod, uncover all the secrets of the Chilean ocean, and become the best fisherman.

Game Features,

  • Master the Progression: The core of the game is growth. Start with a basic rod and work your way up to a legendary boat and gear.,

  • Unlock Gear: Invest your earnings in rods, reels, and hooks to improve your reach, speed, and catch capacity.,

  • Easy to Learn, Satisfying to Master: The ultimate goal is mastery. Get all the upgrades available and unlock all the secrets of the map!,

  • A Plethora of Species: A challenge for collectors. Track, catalog, and learn the behaviors of all available fish species to fill your almanac.,

  • Explore New Zones: Unlock and travel to new fishing areas teeming with rare species as you improve your gear.,

  • A Unique World: Discover environments and creatures inspired by Chile’s wildlife and geography, offering a fresh and unique fishing vibe!,

  • Matagüeo

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5 8th gen or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with 512MB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i7 10th gen or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: PIQUE! Hook'd on Fishing is a satisfying fishing video game with a strong focus on progression and collection. Upgrade your gear, complete your collection of unique marine species, and discover new fishing spots in this relaxing casual game with an action twist.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
